title: Australian reporter and bystander rescue driver from floodwaters
summary_full: Will Murray, an ABC reporter, was covering heavy rain and flooding in Morayfield when a four-wheel drive got submerged. As the driver began to sink, Murray swiftly called for emergency services and then jumped in to help. Joined by bystander Daniel Hainey, they managed to open the door and free the driver from the vehicle. Emergency services arrived shortly after the rescue, emphasizing the dangers of floodwaters.
